title: The Mushroom Cellar
text: A cellar under a ruined house, its steps slick, and below a field of mushrooms glowing soft blue and green in the dark. They are prized by healers and alchemists, and they are very beautiful. The rats down here are very large and very calm.

options.label: Pick the glowing mushrooms. Healers and alchemists pay dearly for them.

outcomes.text: Baskets of soft light, and the rats watch you carry them out.
Spores burst in a pale cloud, and the cellar starts to tilt.

options.label: The toughest eats one, to see what the healers see.

outcomes.text: Visions, then clarity, and the road ahead laid out like a map.

options.label: Take spores home, and grow the light in the dark beneath your own House.

outcomes.text: A crop for the House, grown under its floors. The cellar smells of it for years.
